name: @uarlouski/testrail-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connecting AI assistants directly to TestRail to manage test cases, runs, suites, sections, results, and attachments.
long_description:
An open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connecting AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more) directly to TestRail API v2.

### Key Features
- **Intelligent Discovery**: Browse projects, test suites, sections, and active users.
- **Comprehensive Case Management**: Retrieve, create, update, and bulk-edit test cases with schema-aware custom field validation.
- **Test Execution & Tracking**: Create runs, submit test results by `test_id` or `case_id`, and monitor statuses.
- **Attachments & Media**: Upload screenshots/logs (with directory auto-zipping) and download attachments.
- **Shared Steps**: Manage reusable shared test steps and audit history.
- **Knowledge Base & RAG Export**: Export test cases with sidecar metadata for AI knowledge retrieval.
- **Configurable Security**: Granular controls for read, write, and delete operations.

instance_url.title: TestRail Instance URL
instance_url.description: Base URL of your TestRail instance (e.g. https://example.testrail.io)

username.title: TestRail Username
username.description: Email address used to authenticate with TestRail

api_key.title: TestRail API Key
api_key.description: API key or token for authenticating with the TestRail API (found in My Settings → API Keys)

allow_read_operations.title: Allow Read Operations
allow_read_operations.description: Allow read operations on TestRail (e.g. retrieving projects, test cases, test runs, metadata)

allow_write_operations.title: Allow Write Operations
allow_write_operations.description: Allow write operations on TestRail (e.g. creating/updating test cases, test runs, sections, results)

allow_delete_operations.title: Allow Delete Operations
allow_delete_operations.description: Allow delete operations on TestRail (e.g. deleting cases, shared steps, or attachments)

enable_shared_steps.title: Enable Shared Steps
enable_shared_steps.description: Enable tools for managing reusable shared test steps

enable_case_history.title: Enable Case History
enable_case_history.description: Enable tools for retrieving test case revision and audit history

enable_rag_tools.title: Enable RAG Tools
enable_rag_tools.description: Enable Knowledge Base / RAG export tools (export_cases_for_rag)

enable_deprecated_tools.title: Enable Deprecated Tools
enable_deprecated_tools.description: Enable deprecated tools for backward compatibility. Disable to save context window tokens.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled Tools
disabled_tools.description: Comma-separated list of tool names to disable (e.g. mutate_suite,delete_entity)

enable_telemetry.title: Enable Anonymous Telemetry
enable_telemetry.description: Enable anonymous usage telemetry via Aptabase to help improve the project
